|errata_history={{Card errata/Run'heb Voend}}
This is the original printing: the PC card image current at the set's official release (9 October 2026), first published 9 October 2026. It is not the current version; the current text is [[Run'heb Voend (Errata)]] (PC-E2). The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 9 October 2026<ref name="ht-rv-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/1f401ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Dark/large/runhebvoend.gif runhebvoend.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/1f401ba5a2c0ecb415b43001cefdb9a2f226553b 1f401ba] (9 October 2026).</ref>, no errata mark.  Text: “Once per game, may ▼ a sandcrawler here. While driving a sandcrawler, it moves for free, may not be targeted by weapons, and Voend adds one battle destiny. Once during your turn, may choose a player to activate 1 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Run'heb Voend (Errata)]]): PC card image of 11 October 2026<ref name="ht-rv-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/5aa6ad84446965cd2c9e9567016b93a7bba5876c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Dark/large/runhebvoend.gif runhebvoend.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/5aa6ad84446965cd2c9e9567016b93a7bba5876c 5aa6ad8] (11 October 2026).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: “Voend adds one battle destiny” becomes “Run'heb adds one battle destiny”. Text: “Once per game, may ▼ a sandcrawler here. While driving a sandcrawler, it moves for free, may not be targeted by weapons, and Run'heb adds one battle destiny. Once during your turn, may choose a player to activate 1 Force.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata). 
*: This version's card image was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”; file created 13 October 2026). Released with [[Virtual Set 27]] (9 October 2026); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 13 October 2026, with the same words ([[:File:V27-D-runhebvoend-2026-10-13-sheet-slip.png|slip]]); the slip prints no errata mark. Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip and the card image are one version, on [[Run'heb Voend (Errata)]].
